description: This file defines the PHP class IoTDeviceAdvisorClient in the Aws\IoTDeviceAdvisor namespace, which is used as a client to interact with the AWS IoT Core Device Advisor service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, and fetching suite definitions and runs, as well as tagging resources.

classes.name: IoTDeviceAdvisorClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS IoT Core Device Advisor service.

methods.name: createSuiteDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new suite definition in AWS IoT Core Device Advisor.

methods.name: createSuiteDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new suite definition.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the endpoint for the IoT Device Advisor service.

methods.name: getSuiteDefinition
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific suite definition.

methods.name: getSuiteRun
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific suite run.

methods.name: getSuiteRunReport
methods.description: Gets a report for a specific suite run.

methods.name: getSuiteRunReportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a suite run report.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
